spacr.qt.ai.prompts.tool_approval_note:
Return instructions about tool approval for spaCR's console (GitHub #147).

The vendor CLIs run non-interactively. For Claude Code, the console can offer an
approval dialog after a successful reply when the provider recorded denied tool
calls and a resumable session. Approval supplies tool rules for the next resumed
reply; a rule may cover more than one exact call. Other provider names receive
instructions to give the user a terminal command instead. This function only returns
the instructions; the caller handles any approval and resume.

:param provider_name: the provider's short id, such as ``"claude"``.
:returns: the paragraph to append to the system prompt.
Let the next :meth:`stream_chat` resume ``session_id`` with these
tool calls allowed, for that one reply only.

:param denials: entries of :attr:`last_permission_denials` the user
    approved.
:param session_id: the session they were denied in.
:returns: the ``--allowedTools`` rules that will be passed.
spacr.qt.ai.providers.describe_tool_call:
One line naming what a denied tool call would have done.

:param denial: one ``permission_denials`` entry.
:returns: the command for a shell call, otherwise the tool's name and
    its path, address or pattern.
spacr.qt.ai.providers.tool_rule:
Build a ``--allowedTools`` rule from a denied tool call.

A shell command is allowed as written, ``Bash(gh auth status)``; a web
fetch for its host; any other tool by its name.

:param denial: one ``permission_denials`` entry.
:returns: the rule, or ``""`` when the entry names no tool.
